2607.23493.title: Token-Region Guided Cross-Attention Fusion for Multimodal Affect Interpretation
2607.23493.paper_summary: Automated analysis of multimodal content on social networks has become a critical task for understanding public sentiment and information diffusion in the digital age. However, classifying internet memes remains computationally challenging due to the intricate interplay between visual cues and embedded, often stylized, text, particularly in low-resource languages like Bengali Language. This paper addresses the detection of political intent in Bengali memes by introducing Multimodal Cross-Attention Fusion framework. We first leverage a Vision-Language Model to extract high-fidelity OCR text from noisy meme images. Subsequently, we encode visual and textual features and synthesize them through a cross-modal multi-head attention mechanism that aligns semantic tokens with visual regions. We also investigate the integration of a domain-specific political lexicon as a knowledge prior. Experimental evaluation on the PoliMemeDecode1 dataset shows that our attention-based fusion significantly outperforms unimodal baselines and standard concatenation methods, achieving a state-of-the-art Macro-F1 of approximately 0.94. Interpretability analyzes further confirm that the model effectively learns to ground textual semantics in visual evidence.
2607.23493.paper_summary_zh: 自動化分析社交網絡上的多模態內容已成為理解公共情緒和信息擴散的關鍵任務，尤其是在數位時代。然而，由於視覺提示和嵌入的、通常是風格化的文本之間的複雜互動，對互聯網迷因的分類仍然在計算上具有挑戰性，特別是在資源匱乏的語言如孟加拉語中。本文通過引入多模態交叉注意力融合框架，解決了孟加拉迷因中政治意圖的檢測問題。我們首先利用視覺-語言模型從噪聲迷因圖像中提取高保真度的OCR文本。隨後，我們編碼視覺和文本特徵，並通過交叉模態多頭注意力機制將它們合成，該機制將語義標記與視覺區域對齊。我們還調查了將特定領域的政治詞彙作為知識先驗的整合。在PoliMemeDecode1數據集上的實驗評估顯示，我們基於注意力的融合顯著超越了單模態基準和標準串接方法，達到了約0.94的最先進宏F1分數。可解釋性分析進一步確認該模型有效地學會了將文本語義與視覺證據相對應。
